header_rows_removed.why: Re-applied generators/fetch_exhibit21.py's CORRECTED header filter to this already-parsed artifact. The original filter's first alternative was `subsidiaries?`, whose `?` applies to the final `s` -- it matched 'Subsidiaries' and never 'Subsidiary' -- and it was anchored at ^ only, so 'Legal Name' and 'Company Name' passed as well. All three reached Fluree as legal entities jointly owned by two unrelated filers. See docs/known-issues.md 19.6. Not re-fetched: re-parsing 50 filings would churn every subsidiary name and orphan the 341 stub URIs already in an append-only ledger. The corrected filter drops exactly these rows and nothing else.
